caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) with inference-based methods (x-axis) applied to -trained (Ours) and Standard instruction-tuned models.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates average performance across 11 datasets for three inference-based methods, showing results for “Standard” instruction-tuned models and “Ours” models within each method. The horizontal axis contains the categorical methods labeled (from left to right) “Base,” “CORG,” and “AdaCAD,” and the vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Average Performance,” spanning approximately 48 to 62 with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 units (48, 50, 52, …, 62). Each method is represented by a vertically stacked bar with a legend indicating gray for “Standard” and blue for “Ours”; for “Base,” the bar appears entirely blue, reaching just under 60 (approximately 59), with no visible gray segment. For “CORG,” the gray “Standard” segment extends from about 48 up to roughly 51–52 (≈51.5), and the blue “Ours” segment continues from there up to just under 60 (≈59.5). For “AdaCAD,” the gray “Standard” segment rises from about 48 to around 53–54 (≈53.5), and the blue “Ours” segment extends the total bar height to about 60 (≈60.2). The methods are presented in the stated left-to-right order without an explicit sorting cue, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations, or highlighted bars.
